item.tib: dam can skyes bu'i bskul pa gnam lcags thog mda'
item.coloph: gnam lcags thog mda' zhes bya ba/ bla chen dran pa nam mkhas/ phyi rab (rabs) skal ldan rnams kyi don ched du/ dam can drag po'i bskul pa 'di/ 'om po sgo bzhi'i gnas su mdzad pa'o// mkha' 'gro 'od ldan 'bar ma'i/ (mas) nges med sprang po bdag la/ dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes bco lnga la/ dben gnas khrab ri ngang yag la snyan du brgyud/ kun du ma spel snying gi dkyil du 'chong (chongs/)u ya/ ag tham/ dkar chag yi ge ris su bris pa 'di/ bstan pa'i bka' srung rnams la bzod par gsol/ yi ge 'di bris mthu dpal la brten nas/ bstan dgra nyams pa rtsad nas chod par shog/
